name: config-service-tasks
description: Task runner for config-service (api in src/, admin UI in ui/). Run 'npm run' with no arguments to list all tasks.

scripts.install: npm run install:api && npm run install:ui
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
scripts.lint:api: dotnet build src/ConfigApi.Service.sln && dotnet format src/ConfigApi.Service.sln --verify-no-changes
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:ui
scripts.format: npm run format:api && npm run format:ui
scripts.format:check: dotnet format src/ConfigApi.Service.sln --verify-no-changes && npm run format:check --prefix ui
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run type-check
